title: Battle of Tatarahama (1569)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tatarahama (1569)", at revision 1370275288, opens: "The 1569 Battle of Tatarahama was part of the struggles between the Ōtomo and Mōri samurai clans during Japan's Sengoku period, for control of the island of Kyūshū." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872519, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1569 one of the struggles between the Ōtomo and Mōri samurai clans during Japan's Sengoku period". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
